descriptionByLocale.en:
About the role
For the start of the apprenticeship in August 2027, we are looking for interested young people for the apprenticeship as a logistician/in EFZ. Various materials are delivered and processed every day, and semi-finished and finished products must be stored and shipped. The tasks of the logistician include the receipt of goods, entry inspection, storage and relocation, inventory, warehousing and the packaging and securing of the transported goods, with the aim of providing the right quantity of the right goods in a timely and cost-effective manner at the right place. Forklifts, electric vehicles and other technical aids facilitate physical work. The computer has also made no stop in front of the warehouse, all goods incoming and outgoing must be recorded. Our versatile and exciting basic education allows you an optimal start into the working world.

Your skills and experience
This is what you bring with you:

• Good real or secondary education

• Good school grades in general education, mathematics and German

• Technically interested, logical thinking, motivated, contact and learning

Why you should come to us
This is what awaits you with us:

• Duration of teaching: 3 years

• Interesting training in the adhesive and membrane plant

• Vocational School: 1 day per week in Thun
Your Benefits

• Fair remuneration including 13. Monthly wages

• We cover the costs of teaching materials

• Travel allowance (annual CHF 900.-)

• Provision of work clothes

• Cost sharing on personal laptop

• Participation in language stay 50%

• Health and sports services

• Teaching gift of CHF 500. -
Dedicated professional and practical trainers who provide a family atmosphere make working at Sika special – many call it the Sika spirit. We give everything so that your apprenticeship will take you further at Sika in the long term!
Sika is a great employer – especially for young starters. Learn more from many Sika learners about their teaching professions at www.sika.ch/lehre-duedingen.
Fabian Brotschi, Tel. 058 436 63 33, knows the details of the apprenticeships and is happy to tell you more about the Sika spirit. If you have any questions, we are also available to you by email: [email protected]
Your application with CV, letter of motivation, copies of the school grades and if available Multi/Basic-Check reaches us quickly and safely online via the applicant button of this website.
Do you feel addressed? We look forward to your online application.

We offer competitive remuneration based on local market standards and the specific responsibilities of each job. The remuneration shall be based on the skills, responsibility, education and/or training relevant to the position. We are committed to fair and equitable remuneration schemes in accordance with applicable laws, the Chemicals Tariff Agreement and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemical company, global leader in the development and production of systems and products for gluing, sealing, steaming, reinforcing and protecting in construction and industry. Sika has a global presence with subsidiaries in 103 countries, produces in more than 400 factories, develops innovative technologies for customers around the world and thus contributes significantly to the sustainable transformation in construction and transport. The more than 33,000 employees generated a turnover of CHF 11.2 billion in 2025.

In our R&D department in the area of Adhesive Systems we are looking for a motivated and dedicated Project Leader. As a Project Leader, you will play a central role in the rapid and targeted development of innovative thermal interface materials (TIM) for battery and automotive applications. In particular, the focus is on thermally conductive adhesives (thermal conductive adhesives) and gap fillers.
They translate demanding customer requirements into concrete material concepts and prototypes in the shortest possible time and accompany their development until successful sampling at the customer. You coordinate interdisciplinary development activities and ensure that customer requirements quickly lead to marketable solutions.

• Trial plans are efficient, hypothesis-based and allow quick technical decisions even in the case of incomplete data.

• Maintenance and maintenance of laboratory and equipment as well as ensuring order, cleanliness

• Implementation of technology projects and promotion of innovative ideas with a clear focus on technology development and active generation of technology impulses

• Mind. 3 years of successful development experience with TIM materials, TC fillers, adhesives or sealants

• Professional experience with polymer chemistry - polyurethanes, STP/silane, epoxy, acrylate, silicone

• Experience with Automotive OEM customer projects including direct customer communication

• Very good knowledge of German and English in words and writing, other languages of advantage (Chinese, French, Italian)

• Strong communication and customer orientation

• High implementation and solution orientation

• Quick understanding and pragmatic decision-making

• Networked thinking and creative solution development

• Enforcement and secure prioritization
RELATED

We look forward to your online application. If you have any questions, please contact us at [email protected].

jobs.title: Architect SAP Integration
jobs.description:
About the Role
We’re looking for a Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration to join our SAP Technology team in Zurich. In this strategic assignment, you'll play a critical role of developing and managing complex integration projects, while ensuring the performance, stability, and security of SAP integrations. The Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration shall report to the SAP Integration lead and work in synergy with SAP Development and SAP Basis workstreams, as well as other SAP functional teams.
As a Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration, you will:

• Design, develop, and manage integration architectures using SAP Integration Suite, SAP PO/PI, API Management, and other relevant tools.

• Collaborate with functional and technical teams to define integration requirements and ensure end-to-end solution consistency.

• Ensure smooth operations of all integration interfaces and resolve complex issues in a timely manner.

• Drive the adoption of integration best practices, security standards, and performance optimization techniques.

• Support and mentor a other team members, providing technical guidance and reviewing deliverables.

• Support project delivery teams in integration-related tasks throughout the system development lifecycle.

• Heavily contribute to the cloud adoption journey of SIKA in the integration space.

• Stay current with SAP’s latest integration technologies and trends (e.g., Event Mesh, BTP, APIs, CDS Views).

Your Skills and Experience
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

• 8+ years of experience with SAP integration technologies.

• Strong hands-on experience in:

• SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management)

• Experience with UDFs, Java or Groovy

• SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Orchestration)

• Experience with OData, REST, SOAP APIs

• Solid understanding of BTP (Business Technology Platform)

• Event-driven architecture and event brokers (SAP event mesh, AEM is a plus)

• Experience with IDoc, RFC, ALE, EDI and other SAP integration standards/protocols

• Solid understanding of cloud and hybrid integration scenarios.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Fluent in English. Spanish and German are a plus.

• SAP certification in Integration Suite or similar is a differentiator.

Why Join Us
• Space for Innovation: We value proactive thinkers. You’ll find plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life and drive service improvements.

• An International Atmosphere: Join a supportive local team that operates on a global stage, giving you a unique mix of local community and international exposure.

• Sika – Building Trust. Trust is the most important thing for us. We trust in the capabilities of all our Sika team members - every day.

• Friendly, personable, and often surprisingly uncomplicated, that's how many of our employees describe their working relationship at Sika. We call this the Sika Spirit.

• We offer an attractive employment package with good social benefits, excellent pension fund and accident insurance solutions

• ‘Sikalino’ – an excellent Childcare Center is next to the office

• Discount on public transport or on-site parking

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector toward greater environmental compatibility. With more than 33,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.20 billion in 2025.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration to join our SAP Technology team in Zurich. In this strategic assignment, you'll play a critical role of developing and managing complex integration projects, while ensuring the performance, stability, and security of SAP integrations. The Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration shall report to the SAP Integration lead and work in synergy with SAP Development and SAP Basis workstreams, as well as other SAP functional teams.
As a Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration, you will:

• Design, develop, and manage integration architectures using SAP Integration Suite, SAP PO/PI, API Management, and other relevant tools.

• Collaborate with functional and technical teams to define integration requirements and ensure end-to-end solution consistency.

• Ensure smooth operations of all integration interfaces and resolve complex issues in a timely manner.

• Drive the adoption of integration best practices, security standards, and performance optimization techniques.

• Support and mentor a other team members, providing technical guidance and reviewing deliverables.

• Support project delivery teams in integration-related tasks throughout the system development lifecycle.

• Heavily contribute to the cloud adoption journey of SIKA in the integration space.

• Stay current with SAP’s latest integration technologies and trends (e.g., Event Mesh, BTP, APIs, CDS Views).

Your Skills and Experience
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

• 8+ years of experience with SAP integration technologies.

• Strong hands-on experience in:

• SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management)

• Experience with UDFs, Java or Groovy

• SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Orchestration)

• Experience with OData, REST, SOAP APIs

• Solid understanding of BTP (Business Technology Platform)

• Event-driven architecture and event brokers (SAP event mesh, AEM is a plus)

• Experience with IDoc, RFC, ALE, EDI and other SAP integration standards/protocols

• Solid understanding of cloud and hybrid integration scenarios.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Fluent in English. Spanish and German are a plus.

• SAP certification in Integration Suite or similar is a differentiator.

Why Join Us
• Space for Innovation: We value proactive thinkers. You’ll find plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life and drive service improvements.

• An International Atmosphere: Join a supportive local team that operates on a global stage, giving you a unique mix of local community and international exposure.

• Sika – Building Trust. Trust is the most important thing for us. We trust in the capabilities of all our Sika team members - every day.

• Friendly, personable, and often surprisingly uncomplicated, that's how many of our employees describe their working relationship at Sika. We call this the Sika Spirit.

• We offer an attractive employment package with good social benefits, excellent pension fund and accident insurance solutions

• ‘Sikalino’ – an excellent Childcare Center is next to the office

• Discount on public transport or on-site parking

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector toward greater environmental compatibility. With more than 33,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.20 billion in 2025.

• You as a team ensure that our plastic products are manufactured and further developed

• You learn to set up and operate the production facilities independently

• You check the manufactured products for their quality

• You will learn the care and maintenance of technical equipment

• Accompany and work on interesting projects in the team, e.g. new tools & parts changes, material tests

• Do you feel comfortable in an environment where you can discover and develop your own strengths?

• Are you interested in physical and chemical relationships and mathematics?

• Do you have good spatial imagination?

Why you should come to us
With us, you take responsibility, contribute your ideas and make a visible contribution to the success of our location. You can expect a stable environment, modern infrastructure and a team that works together and supports each other. We maintain an open and uncomplicated du-culture across all hierarchical levels.
Sika is a great employer – especially for young starters. Learn more from our location in Romanshorn on YouTube. Baftir Arifoski (email: [email protected]) knows the details and is happy to tell you more about the Sika spirit.

Sika is a global company with over 33,000 employees. Through constant innovation and high quality, Sika is a leading producer of specialty chemicals for construction and industry in the fields of densities, gluing, steaming, reinforcement and protection.

Their technologies increase the safety and comfort of vehicles and help reduce the weight of future vehicles. The goal is for vehicles to be more stable and calmer on the road and for production to become more efficient and flexible.
For the start of the apprenticeship in August 2027, we are looking for young people in the Automotive AG division in Romanshorn TG, interested in the beautiful Lake Constance, for the apprenticeship as a plastics technologist EFZ.

- Acquisition of Ostwind Abo

- Semester premiums

- A strong team that is committed and motivated

- 40 hours/week

- Coffee, Water & Tea are available for free

In this highly visible role, you will lead three key areas of responsibility: global key account management for Off-Highway Vehicles, the strategic development of the Americas region, and the growth of the Off-Highway Vehicles segment across Europe. By shaping market strategy, building strong customer partnerships, and identifying new business opportunities, you will play a pivotal role in expanding Sika's global market position.
We are looking for a recognized industry expert with deep expertise in adhesive technologies and their applications within commercial transportation, combined with the commercial acumen and strategic mindset required to translate technical knowledge into sustainable business growth.
Main Tasks:

• Drive business growth across Transportation customer segments with a focus on the Americas

• Lead key initiatives for business expansion into additional applications on global scale

• Identify new business opportunities through market analysis and customer engagement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and industry partners

• Develop and execute growth initiatives in collaboration with regional and global teams

• Support sales organizations in customer acquisition and market expansion

• Lead strategic projects, track business opportunities, and drive innovation

• Deliver training, support marketing activities, and represent Sika at industry events

• Manage and grow selected global key accounts, including commercial negotiations and strategic planning

Your Skills and Experience
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field

• Extensive knowledge of Adhesive technologies gained through 5-10 years of experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Sales roles

• In-depth knowledge of the Commercial Transportation industry , including market dynamics and customer requirements

• Proven success in driving business growth through Business Development, Sales, Strategic Marketing, or Product Management, supported by several years of relevant experience.

• International business experience, ideally with exposure to the Americas/USA market

• Fluent in English; additional language skills such as Spanish, German, or French are an asset

• Strong commercial acumen combined with technical understanding

• Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills

• Entrepreneurial mindset, strategic thinking

• Readiness to travel internationally up to 30%

Why Join Us
We look forward to your application. For this position, only direct applications will be considered. For any further information please reach us at [email protected]

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. Approximately 33,000 employees generated CHF 11.20 billion in sales in 2025.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo
Unisciti a Sika a livello aziendale globale e guidare la crescita del nostro business Adhesive Technologies all'interno del settore dei trasporti commerciali. In questo ruolo altamente visibile, guiderete tre aree chiave di responsabilità: la gestione globale del conto chiave per i veicoli fuoristrada, lo sviluppo strategico della regione delle Americhe, e la crescita del segmento dei veicoli fuoristrada in tutta Europa. Definendo la strategia di mercato, costruendo forti partnership con i clienti e identificando nuove opportunità di business, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'espansione della posizione di mercato globale di Sika.
Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto di settore riconosciuto con profonda esperienza nelle tecnologie adesive e nelle loro applicazioni all'interno del trasporto commerciale, combinato con l'acumen commerciale e la mentalità strategica necessaria per tradurre la conoscenza tecnica in crescita aziendale sostenibile.
Compiti principali:

• Aumentare la crescita aziendale attraverso i segmenti dei clienti di trasporto con un focus sulle Americhe

• Iniziative chiave per l'espansione aziendale in applicazioni aggiuntive su scala globale

• Identificare nuove opportunità di business attraverso l'analisi del mercato e l'impegno del cliente

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti con i clienti chiave e partner industriali

• Sviluppare ed eseguire iniziative di crescita in collaborazione con team regionali e globali

• Sostenere le organizzazioni di vendita nell'acquisizione dei clienti e nell'espansione del mercato

• Guidare progetti strategici, monitorare le opportunità di business e guidare l'innovazione

• Fornire attività di formazione, supporto marketing e rappresentare Sika agli eventi del settore

• Gestione e crescita di account chiave globali selezionati, compresi i negoziati commerciali e la pianificazione strategica

Le tue abilità ed esperienza
• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria, Business Administration, o un campo relativo

• Ampia conoscenza delle tecnologie adesive acquisite attraverso 5-10 anni di esperienza in Business Development, Key Account Management o ruoli di vendita

• Conoscenza approfondita dell'industria dei trasporti commerciali, comprese le dinamiche di mercato e i requisiti dei clienti

• Risultato successo nella crescita aziendale attraverso lo sviluppo aziendale, le vendite, il marketing strategico o la gestione dei prodotti, supportato da diversi anni di esperienza rilevante.

• Esperienza aziendale internazionale, idealmente con esposizione al mercato Americas/USA

• Fluente in inglese; competenze linguistiche aggiuntive come spagnolo, tedesco o francese sono un bene

• Forte acume commerciale combinato con la comprensione tecnica

• Ottima comunicazione, creazione di relazioni e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder

• mentalità imprenditoriale, pensiero strategico

• Prontezza di viaggiare a livello internazionale fino al 30%

Perché unirsi a noi
Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione. Per questa posizione, saranno prese in considerazione solo applicazioni dirette. Per ulteriori informazioni contattateci all'indirizzo [email protected]

Offriamo stipendi competitivi, allineati con i benchmark del mercato locale e la portata e le responsabilità specifiche di ogni ruolo. Il compenso è determinato competenze basate rilevanti per la posizione, l'istruzione e/o la formazione. Ci impegniamo a pratiche di pagamento equa ed equa in conformità con le leggi e i regolamenti applicabili.

A proposito di Sika
Sika è una società specializzata di prodotti chimici con una posizione leader a livello globale nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi e prodotti per l'associazione, la sigillatura, l'umidità, il rafforzamento e la protezione nel settore edilizio e industriale. Sika ha filiali in 102 paesi in tutto il mondo, produce in oltre 400 fabbriche e sviluppa tecnologie innovative per i clienti in tutto il mondo. In tal modo, svolge un ruolo cruciale nel consentire la trasformazione delle industrie di costruzione e trasporto verso una maggiore compatibilità ambientale. Circa 33.000 dipendenti hanno generato un fatturato di 11,20 miliardi di franchi nel 2025.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Rolle
Treten Sie Sika auf globaler Unternehmensebene bei und treiben Sie das Wachstum unseres Geschäfts mit Klebstofftechnologien in der gewerblichen Transportbranche voran. In dieser sehr sichtbaren Rolle werden Sie drei wichtige Verantwortungsbereiche leiten: das globale Key Account Management für Off-Highway-Fahrzeuge, die strategische Entwicklung der Region Amerika und das Wachstum des Segments Off-Highway-Fahrzeuge in ganz Europa. Durch die Gestaltung der Marktstrategie, den Aufbau starker Kundenpartnerschaften und die Identifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle beim Ausbau der globalen Marktposition von Sika.
Wir suchen einen anerkannten Branchenexperten mit fundierter Expertise in Klebstofftechnologien und deren Anwendungen im gewerblichen Transport, kombiniert mit dem kommerziellen Scharfsinn und der strategischen Denkweise, die erforderlich sind, um technisches Wissen in nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum umzusetzen.
Hauptaufgaben:

• Steigerung des Geschäftswachstums in allen Kundensegmenten von Transportation mit Fokus auf Amerika

• Führen Sie wichtige Initiativen zur Geschäftsexpansion in zusätzliche Anwendungen auf globaler Ebene

• Identifizieren Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch Marktanalyse und Kundenbindung

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden und Industriepartnern

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wachstumsinitiativen in Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen und globalen Teams

• Unterstützung von Vertriebsorganisationen bei der Kundenakquise und Marktexpansion

• Leiten Sie strategische Projekte, verfolgen Sie Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und treiben Sie Innovationen voran

• Bereitstellung von Schulungen, Unterstützung von Marketingaktivitäten und Vertretung von Sika bei Branchenveranstaltungen

• Verwalten und Wachstum ausgewählter globaler Key Accounts, einschließlich kommerzieller Verhandlungen und strategischer Planung

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Engineering, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Klebstofftechnologien durch 5-10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Key Account Management oder Sales Rollen gewonnen

• Tiefe Kenntnisse der gewerblichen Transportbranche, einschließlich Marktdynamik und Kundenanforderungen

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Förderung des Geschäftswachstums durch Geschäftsentwicklung, Vertrieb, strategisches Marketing oder Produktmanagement, unterstützt durch mehrere Jahre einschlägiger Erfahrung.

• Internationale Geschäftserfahrung, idealerweise mit Exposition gegenüber dem Amerika / USA Markt

• fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse wie Spanisch, Deutsch oder Französisch sind eine Bereicherung

• Starker kommerzieller Scharfsinn kombiniert mit technischem Verständnis

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, Beziehungsaufbau und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten

• Unternehmerische Denkweise, strategisches Denken

• Bereitschaft, international bis zu 30% zu reisen

Warum kommen Sie zu uns
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Für diese Position werden nur direkte Anträge berücksichtigt. Für weitere Informationen kontaktieren Sie uns bitte unter [email protected]

Wir bieten wettbewerbsfähige Gehälter, die auf lokale Marktbenchmarks und den spezifischen Umfang und die Verantwortlichkeiten jeder Rolle abgestimmt sind. Die Vergütung wird auf der Grundlage von Fähigkeiten festgelegt, die für die Position, Ausbildung und / oder Ausbildung relevant sind. Wir verpflichten uns zu fairen und gerechten Vergütungspraktiken in Übereinstimmung mit geltenden Gesetzen und Vorschriften.

Über Sika
Sika ist ein Spezialchemieunternehmen mit einer weltweit führenden Position in der Entwicklung und Produktion von Systemen und Produkten für Kleben, Abdichten, Dämpfen, Bewehren und Schutz im Bausektor und in der Industrie. Sika hat Tochtergesellschaften in 102 Ländern auf der ganzen Welt, produziert in über 400 Fabriken und entwickelt innovative Technologien für Kunden weltweit. Dabei spielt es eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Transformation der Bau- und Transportindustrie hin zu einer besseren Umweltverträglichkeit. Rund 33.000 Mitarbeiter erwirtschafteten 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 11.20 Milliarden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos du rôle
Rejoignez Sika à l'échelle mondiale et dirigez la croissance de notre activité Technologies Adhésives au sein de l'industrie du transport commercial. Dans ce rôle très visible, vous dirigerez trois domaines de responsabilité clés : la gestion des comptes clés mondiaux des véhicules hors route, le développement stratégique de la région des Amériques et la croissance du segment des véhicules hors route en Europe. En élaborant une stratégie de marché, en établissant de solides partenariats avec les clients et en identifiant de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'expansion de la position de marché mondiale de Sika.
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un expert reconnu de l'industrie avec une expertise approfondie dans les technologies adhésives et leurs applications dans le transport commercial, combiné avec l'acuité commerciale et l'esprit stratégique requis pour traduire les connaissances techniques en croissance durable des entreprises.
Principales tâches:

• Favoriser la croissance des entreprises dans tous les segments de la clientèle du transport, en mettant l'accent sur les Amériques

• Diriger les initiatives clés pour l'expansion des entreprises vers des applications supplémentaires à l'échelle mondiale

• Identifier de nouvelles possibilités commerciales grâce à l'analyse du marché et à l'engagement des clients

• Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux clients et partenaires de l'industrie

• Élaborer et exécuter des initiatives de croissance en collaboration avec des équipes régionales et mondiales

• Soutenir les organisations de vente dans l'acquisition de clients et l'expansion du marché

• Diriger les projets stratégiques, suivre les occasions d'affaires et stimuler l'innovation

• Offrir de la formation, soutenir les activités de marketing et représenter Sika lors d'événements industriels

• Gérer et développer certains comptes clés mondiaux, y compris les négociations commerciales et la planification stratégique

Vos compétences et votre expérience
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Connaissance approfondie des technologies adhésives acquises grâce à 5-10 ans d'expérience en développement des affaires, gestion des comptes clés ou rôles de vente

• Connaissance approfondie de l'industrie des transports commerciaux , y compris la dynamique du marché et les exigences des clients

• Succès prouvé dans la croissance d'entreprise par le développement d'affaires, les ventes, le marketing stratégique ou la gestion de produits, soutenu par plusieurs années d'expérience pertinente.

• Expérience commerciale internationale, idéalement avec une exposition au marché américain/américain

• La maîtrise de l'anglais; des compétences linguistiques supplémentaires comme l'espagnol, l'allemand ou le français sont un atout

• Forte acuité commerciale associée à une compréhension technique

• Excellente capacité de communication, d'établissement de relations et de gestion des intervenants

• Esprit d'entreprise, pensée stratégique

• Disponibilité à voyager à l'étranger jusqu'à 30%

Pourquoi nous rejoindre
Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature. Pour ce poste, seules les demandes directes seront prises en considération. Pour tout renseignement complémentaire, veuillez nous contacter à [email protected]

Nous offrons des salaires concurrentiels, conformes aux critères du marché local et à la portée et aux responsabilités spécifiques de chaque rôle. La rémunération est déterminée en fonction des compétences liées au poste, à l'éducation ou à la formation. Nous sommes attachés à des pratiques salariales justes et équitables conformément aux lois et règlements applicables.

À propos de Sika
Sika est une société chimique spécialisée qui occupe une position de leader mondial dans le développement et la production de systèmes et de produits pour le collage, l'étanchéité, l'amortissement, le renforcement et la protection dans le secteur du bâtiment et l'industrie. Sika a des filiales dans 102 pays à travers le monde, produit dans plus de 400 usines et développe des technologies innovantes pour les clients dans le monde entier. Ce faisant, il joue un rôle crucial en permettant la transformation des industries de la construction et des transports vers une meilleure compatibilité environnementale. Environ 33 000 employés ont généré des ventes de CHF 11,20 milliards en 2025.

• Umfassende Störungsanalyse und Fehlerbehebung

• Umbau-, Montage- und Reparaturarbeiten an Kunststoffspritzgussmaschinen bis 1000t und technischen Betriebsmitteln (Handlingsysteme, Peripheriegeräte, Haustechnik)

• Führen und Pflegen der Wartungsdatenbanken

• Eigenverantwortliche Beschaffung und administrative Abwicklung von Ersatzteilen sowie bereichsübergreifenden Materialbestellungen

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• Ausbildung zum Industrie-/ Polymechaniker o.ä.,

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung vorzugsweise in der kunststoffverarbeitenden Industrie (Spritzgusstechnik)

• Hydraulik- und Pneumatikkenntnisse erforderlich

• Elektrik- und IT-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

• Sehr selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigeninitiative und hohem Sicherheitsbewusstsein

• Aufgeschlossener Teamplayer mit starken kommunikativen und sozialen Fähigkeiten

Bei uns übernehmen Sie Verantwortung, bringen Ihre Ideen ein und leisten einen sichtbaren Beitrag zum Erfolg unseres Standorts. Es erwartet Sie ein stabiles Umfeld, moderne Infrastruktur und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Für diese Stellenausschreibung möchten wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen!

Wir bieten wettbewerbsfähige Vergütungen, die sich an den lokalen Marktstandards und den spezifischen Aufgabenbereichen jeder Stelle orientieren. Die Vergütung richtet sich nach den für die Position relevanten Fähigkeiten, Verantwortung, der Ausbildung und/oder der Weiterbildung. Wir verpflichten uns zu fairen und gerechten Vergütungssystematiken in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden Gesetzen, dem Tarifvertag Chemie und Vorschriften.

Über Sika
Sika ist ein Unternehmen der Spezialitätenchemie, global führend in der Entwicklung und Produktion von Systemen und Produkten zum Kleben, Dichten, Dämpfen, Verstärken und Schützen im Bau und in der

Industrie. Sika ist weltweit präsent mit Tochtergesellschaften in 103 Ländern, produziert in über 400 Fabriken, entwickelt innovative Technologien für Kunden rund um den Globus und trägt damit massgeblich zur nachhaltigen Transformation im Bau- und Transportwesen bei. Die mehr als 33’000 Mitarbeitenden erwirtschafteten im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 11.20 Milliarden.

• Spannende technische Herausforderungen mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

• Gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bis hin zur Expertenrolle

descriptionByLocale.en:
About the role
You want to make a difference? Then you are exactly right with us!
Imagine: The products you prepare and ship in Birr will later be used in tunnels, high-rise buildings, bridges or sports stadiums around the world. For this to work, you need people who keep track and like to tackle.
Start your professional future at Sika and become part of a team that works together to ensure that everything arrives at the right place at the right time. For the start of the apprenticeship in August 2027, we are looking for a motivated personality for the apprenticeship as a logistician/in EFZ.
During your teaching, you are not only a spectator, but right from the start:

• You take goods and control the deliveries

• Learn how to properly store and manage products

• You put together customer orders and make them ready for shipping

• You work with modern technical tools and learn how to deal with forklifters

• You will get exciting insights into the processes of a large logistics center

• You take on more responsibility step by step

• You work with a team that supports and promotes you

Your skills and experience
You bring that with you

• You like to be active, get involved and do not want to sit at your desk all day

• You are interested in technology, logistics and organization

• You work reliably and carefully

• You are motivated to learn new things

• You like working in a team

• You have successfully completed Real or Secondary School

Why you should come to us
You can look forward to that.

• An exciting and varied teaching with a lot of practice

• Experienced vocational trainers who accompany you

• A great team and a family working environment

• Modern equipment and innovative logistics processes

• Attractive development opportunities during and after teaching.
Why Sika?

We entrust you with responsibility, promote your development and support you in developing your potential. Many of our learners remain with Sika even after their education and continue to develop professionally.
Ready for your next step?

Find out more about our apprenticeships at www.sika.ch/lehrstellen.

Nihaila Iaquinta, HR generalist (tel. +41 58 436 54 23), is happy to answer your questions. We look forward to your online application!

The remuneration shall be based on the skills, responsibility, education and/or training relevant to the position. We are committed to fair and equitable remuneration schemes in accordance with applicable laws, the Chemicals Tariff Agreement and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemical company, global leader in the development and production of systems and products for gluing, sealing, steaming, reinforcing and protecting in construction and industry. The more than 33,000 employees generated a turnover of CHF 11.20 billion in 2025.

jobs.description:
Über die Rolle
Als Teil unseres Instandhaltungsteams am Produktionsstandort Düdingen/FR suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung einen Betriebsmechaniker (m/w). Folgende spannende Arbeiten erwarten Sie:

• Vorbeugende Wartung und Instandhaltung (TPM) an vielseitigen Produktionsanlagen

• Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung zusammen mit der Produktion

• Laufende Optimierung unserer Anlagen, um Verfügbarkeit und Leistung zu steigern (KVP)

• Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Anlagen sowie Mitarbeit in Erweiterungs- und Optimierungsprojekten mit internen und externen Partnern

• Definition und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen und Arbeitsmaterialien

• Praxisbildner für unsere Polymechaniker-Lernenden

• Aktive Mitgestaltung einer modernen, präventiv ausgerichteten Instandhaltung

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Polymechaniker/in oder Instandhaltungsmechaniker/in

• Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Industrieanlagen von Vorteil

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Pneumatik und Hydraulik

• Elektrokenntnisse von Vorteil, Anschlussbewilligung nach NIV Art. 15 oder Bereitschaft, diese zu erwerben

• Bereitschaft für Piketteinsätze und vereinzelte Wochenendeinsätze

• Sicherheits- und umweltbewusstes Handeln

• Sie übernehmen gerne Verantwortung, arbeiten selbständig und zielorientiert und sind gerne Teil eines Teams

• gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Vertrauen ist für uns das Wichtigste. Wir vertrauen auf Ihre Fähigkeiten und ermöglichen Ihnen viele Gestaltungsräume - jeden Tag aufs Neue.

Über die Rolle
Als Teil unseres Instandhaltungsteams am Produktionsstandort Düdingen/FR suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung einen Betriebsmechaniker (m/w). Folgende spannende Arbeiten erwarten Sie:

• Vorbeugende Wartung und Instandhaltung (TPM) an vielseitigen Produktionsanlagen

• Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung zusammen mit der Produktion

• Laufende Optimierung unserer Anlagen, um Verfügbarkeit und Leistung zu steigern (KVP)

• Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Anlagen sowie Mitarbeit in Erweiterungs- und Optimierungsprojekten mit internen und externen Partnern

• Definition und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen und Arbeitsmaterialien

• Praxisbildner für unsere Polymechaniker-Lernenden

• Aktive Mitgestaltung einer modernen, präventiv ausgerichteten Instandhaltung

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Polymechaniker/in oder Instandhaltungsmechaniker/in

• Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Industrieanlagen von Vorteil

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Pneumatik und Hydraulik

• Elektrokenntnisse von Vorteil, Anschlussbewilligung nach NIV Art. 15 oder Bereitschaft, diese zu erwerben

• Bereitschaft für Piketteinsätze und vereinzelte Wochenendeinsätze

• Sicherheits- und umweltbewusstes Handeln

• Sie übernehmen gerne Verantwortung, arbeiten selbständig und zielorientiert und sind gerne Teil eines Teams

• gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Warum Sie zu uns kommen sollten
Vertrauen ist für uns das Wichtigste. Wir vertrauen auf Ihre Fähigkeiten und ermöglichen Ihnen viele Gestaltungsräume - jeden Tag aufs Neue.
Die Möglichkeit, neue Ideen einzubringen, interessante Entwicklungsfelder und die frühe Übernahme von Verantwortung sind einige der Schlüsselfaktoren, die den Pioniergeist von Sika ausmachen.
Sika ist eine grossartige Arbeitgeberin - speziell auch für Mitarbeitende, welche Wert auf gute Zusammenarbeit legen.
Bei Fragen erteilt Ihnen Frau Jacqueline Zbinden, HR Manager, gerne weitere Auskünfte (Tel. 058 436 6105). Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen? Es werden nur online Bewerbungen über den Bewerber-Button dieser Seite berücksichtigt. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung und Sie kennen zu lernen!

Wir bieten wettbewerbsfähige Vergütungen, die sich an den lokalen Marktstandards und den spezifischen Aufgabenbereichen jeder Stelle orientieren. Die Vergütung richtet sich nach den für die Position relevanten Fähigkeiten, Verantwortung, der Ausbildung und/oder der Weiterbildung. Wir verpflichten uns zu fairen und gerechten Vergütungssystematiken in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden Gesetzen, dem Tarifvertag Chemie und Vorschriften.

Über Sika
Sika ist ein Unternehmen der Spezialitätenchemie, global führend in der Entwicklung und Produktion von Systemen und Produkten zum Kleben, Dichten, Dämpfen, Verstärken und Schützen im Bau und in der Industrie. Sika ist weltweit präsent mit Tochtergesellschaften in 103 Ländern, produziert in über 400 Fabriken, entwickelt innovative Technologien für Kunden rund um den Globus und trägt damit massgeblich zur nachhaltigen Transformation im Bau- und Transportwesen bei. Die mehr als 33’000 Mitarbeitenden erwirtschafteten im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 11.2 Milliarden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le rôle
Dans le cadre de notre équipe de maintenance sur le site de production de Düdingen/FR, nous recherchons un mécanicien opérationnel (h/f) immédiatement ou par accord. Les travaux passionnants suivants vous attendent:

• Entretien et entretien préventifs dans des installations de production polyvalentes

• Analyse des défauts et dépannage avec production

• Optimisation continue de nos installations pour augmenter la disponibilité et la performance (CIP)

• Installation et mise en service des installations ainsi que participation à des projets d'expansion et d'optimisation avec des partenaires internes et externes

• Définition et achat de pièces de rechange et de matériaux de travail

• Formateurs pratiques pour nos apprenants en polymécanique

• Participation active à la maintenance préventive moderne

Vos compétences et votre expérience
• Formation professionnelle complétée en tant que mécanicien polymécanique ou mécanicien de maintenance

• L'expérience de l'entretien des installations industrielles est un avantage

• Connaissance sonore des pneumatiques et de l'hydraulique

• Connaissance électrique de l'avantage, permis de raccordement selon l'article 15 de la NIV ou volonté de les acquérir

• Préparation pour les picquettes et les inserts isolés du week-end

• Sécurité et sensibilisation à l'environnement

• Ils aiment assumer leurs responsabilités, travailler de manière indépendante et orientée vers les objectifs et sont heureux de faire partie d'une équipe

• Une bonne connaissance orale et écrite de l'allemand est requise

Pourquoi tu devrais venir nous voir?
La confiance est la chose la plus importante pour nous. Nous faisons confiance à vos compétences et vous fournissons de nombreux espaces de design - chaque jour à nouveau.
La possibilité d'apporter de nouvelles idées, des domaines de développement intéressants et une prise de responsabilité précoce sont quelques-uns des facteurs clés qui composent l'esprit pionnier de Sika.
Sika est un excellent employeur, surtout pour les employés qui apprécient une bonne coopération.
Si vous avez des questions, Jacqueline Zbinden, HR Manager, sera heureuse de vous fournir de plus amples informations (tél. 058 436 6105). Vous sentez-vous adressé? Seules les demandes en ligne sont examinées via le bouton candidat de cette page. Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature et de vous connaître!

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle basée sur les normes du marché local et les responsabilités spécifiques de chaque emploi. La rémunération est fondée sur les compétences, les responsabilités, l'éducation et/ou la formation pertinentes au poste. Nous sommes attachés à des régimes de rémunération justes et équitables, conformément aux lois applicables, à l'Accord tarifaire sur les produits chimiques et aux règlements.

À propos de Sika
Sika est une société chimique spécialisée, leader mondial dans le développement et la production de systèmes et de produits de collage, d'étanchéité, de vapeur, de renforcement et de protection dans la construction et l'industrie. Sika a une présence mondiale avec des filiales dans 103 pays, produit dans plus de 400 usines, développe des technologies innovantes pour les clients à travers le monde et contribue ainsi de manière significative à la transformation durable dans la construction et le transport. Plus de 33 000 salariés ont généré un chiffre d'affaires de CHF 11,2 milliards en 2025.

jobs.description:
Über die Rolle
• Führung und Weiterentwicklung der internationalen Quality Teams in Romanshorn, Widen und Saintes sowie aktive Gestaltung der neuen, integrierten Quality Organisation für den Bereich Injection Molding

• Verantwortung für die Implementierung, Aufrechterhaltung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems innerhalb des Injection Molding Geschäfts

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards und kundenspezifischer Anforderungen, insbesondere IATF 16949, VDA 6.3 und TISAX

• Verantwortung als Quality Management Representative (QMR) sowie Übernahme der Funktionen PSB/PSCR und ISR für den Bereich Injection Molding

• Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der Qualitätsplanung unter Anwendung der Automotive Core Tools wie APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC und MSA

• Verantwortung für das Qualitätsmanagement gegenüber Kunden und externen Produktionspartnern sowie für das Reklamationsmanagement und die Sicherstellung nachhaltiger Korrektur- und Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Planung und Koordination von System-, Prozess-, Produkt- und Kundenaudits sowie Begleitung von Zertifizierungen und Re-Zertifizierungen

• Definition und Überwachung relevanter Qualitätskennzahlen sowie Ableitung und Umsetzung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Sicherstellung der Produkt- und Prozessqualität in der Serienproduktion sowie Verantwortung für die Qualifizierung, Validierung und Freigabe neuer Materialien, Compounds

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Lieferanten, externen Produktionspartnern sowie internen und internationalen Schnittstellen

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, Qualitätsmanagement oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement der Automobilindustrie, idealerweise im Bereich Injection Molding oder Kunststoffverarbeitung

• Nachweisbare Führungserfahrung in der Leitung und Weiterentwicklung internationaler und interdisziplinärer Teams

• Fundierte Kenntnisse der Automotive-Qualitätsstandards und -anforderungen, insbesondere IATF 16949, VDA 6.3 und Customer Specific Requirements (CSR)

• Sehr gute praktische Kenntnisse der Automotive Core Tools wie APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC und MSA

• Erfahrung im Kunden- und Lieferantenqualitätsmanagement, Reklamationsmanagement sowie in der Planung und Durchführung von Audits

• Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Projektmanagement- und Kommunikationskompetenz sowie souveräner Umgang mit unterschiedlichen internationalen Stakeholdern

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

• Internationale Reisebereitschaft

Warum Sie zu uns kommen sollten
Bei uns übernehmen Sie Verantwortung, bringen Ihre Ideen ein und leisten einen sichtbaren Beitrag zum Erfolg unseres Standorts. Es erwartet Sie ein stabiles Umfeld, moderne Infrastruktur und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Dabei pflegen wir eine offene und unkomplizierte Du-Kultur über alle Hierarchiestufen hinweg.
Für diese Stellenausschreibung möchten wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen!

Wir bieten wettbewerbsfähige Vergütungen, die sich an den lokalen Marktstandards und den spezifischen Aufgabenbereichen jeder Stelle orientieren. Die Vergütung richtet sich nach den für die Position relevanten Fähigkeiten, Verantwortung, der Ausbildung und/oder der Weiterbildung. Wir verpflichten uns zu fairen und gerechten Vergütungssystematiken in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden Gesetzen, dem Tarifvertag Chemie und Vorschriften.

Über Sika
Sika ist ein Unternehmen der Spezialitätenchemie, global führend in der Entwicklung und Produktion von Systemen und Produkten zum Kleben, Dichten, Dämpfen, Verstärken und Schützen im Bau und in der

Industrie. Sika ist weltweit präsent mit Tochtergesellschaften in 103 Ländern, produziert in über 400 Fabriken, entwickelt innovative Technologien für Kunden rund um den Globus und trägt damit massgeblich zur nachhaltigen Transformation im Bau- und Transportwesen bei. Die mehr als 33’000 Mitarbeitenden erwirtschafteten im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 11.20 Milliarden.
Für unseren Standort in Romanshorn TG , am schönen Bodensee, suchen wir eine erfahrene und engagierte Führungspersönlichkeit als Quality Manager Injection Molding, die unsere internationale Quality Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt.

• Langfristige Perspektive in einem global erfolgreichen und gleichzeitig lokal verankerten Unternehmen

• Spannende technische Herausforderungen mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

• Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – fachlich wie persönlich

• Attraktives Pensionskassenmodell mit individuellen Wahlmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche

• Mindestens 25 Ferientage sowie zusätzliche Ferientage ab dem 40. und 50. Altersjahr

• Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer offenen Unternehmenskultur

• Kostenlose Parkplätze sowie kostenloser Kaffee, Tee und Mineralwasser

jobs.description:
Über die Rolle
Du schliesst demnächst dein Studium ab und suchst einen Berufseinstieg in Festanstellung? Bei uns lernst du die vielseitigen Tätigkeiten eines Produktingenieurs kennen. Für unser professionelles und gut eingespieltes Team im Geschäftsbereich Business Support, Technical Department der Sika Schweiz AG suchen wir nach Vereinbarung in Zürich-Altstetten eine engagierte, fachlich und menschlich überzeugende Persönlichkeit als Junior Produktingenieur/in (80-100%).
In dieser Tätigkeit bist du für folgende Aufgaben verantwortlich:

• Begleitung und Einführung in verschiedene Teilsortimente durch erfahrene Produktingenieure

• Betreuen eines kleinen Produktsortiments hinsichtlich technischer und anwendungstechnischer Leistungsfähigkeit

• Erarbeiten von Produktdatenblättern, Applikationsrichtlinien und anderen technischen Dokumenten

• Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Projekten (Marktstudien, Marktbearbeitungspläne)

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• Ein Hochschulstudium als Bauingenieur, Wirtschaftschemiker oder Materialwissenschafter

• Berufspraxis in der Baubranche ist von Vorteil

• Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, kommunizierst stilsicher in Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse (mündlich und schriftlich)

• Zu deinen Stärken zählen hohe Eigenmotivation und -initiative, Freude am Kundenkontakt und natürlich der nötige Biss

Warum Sie zu uns kommen sollten
• Einstiegsstelle in eine technische Funktion als Produktingenieur

• Intensive Einarbeitung (6-12 Mte.) – Begleitung durch erfahrene Produktingenieure/-innen als Mentoren

• Vertrauen ist für uns das Wichtigste. Wir vertrauen auf deine Fähigkeiten und ermöglichen dir viele Gestaltungsräume – jeden Tag aufs Neue

• Unkomplizierte Führungskräfte, die Vertrauen schenken und eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit einem freundlichen Umgangston - das macht das Arbeiten bei Sika speziell – viele bei uns nennen es den Sika-Spirit
Die Sika ist eine grossartige Arbeitgeberin – speziell für Mitarbeitende, welche auf Vertrauen in der Zusammenarbeit setzen.
Wir freuen uns über dein vollständiges Bewerbungsdossier.

Die Vergütung richtet sich nach den für die Position relevanten Fähigkeiten, Verantwortung, der Ausbildung und/oder der Weiterbildung. Wir verpflichten uns zu fairen und gerechten Vergütungssystematiken in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden Gesetzen, dem Tarifvertag Chemie und Vorschriften.

Über Sika
Sika ist ein Unternehmen der Spezialitätenchemie, global führend in der Entwicklung und Produktion von Systemen und Produkten zum Kleben, Dichten, Dämpfen, Verstärken und Schützen im Bau und in der Industrie. Sika ist weltweit präsent mit Tochtergesellschaften in 103 Ländern, produziert in über 400 Fabriken, entwickelt innovative Technologien für Kunden rund um den Globus und trägt damit massgeblich zur nachhaltigen Transformation im Bau- und Transportwesen bei. descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo
Stai completando i tuoi studi presto e alla ricerca di un inizio di carriera nell'occupazione permanente? Con noi conoscerete le attività versatili di un ingegnere del prodotto. Per il nostro team professionale e consolidato nel Business Support, Dipartimento Tecnico di Sika Schweiz AG, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata, professionale e umanamente convincente come ingegnere del prodotto junior (80-100%) dopo l'accordo a Zurigo-Altstetten.
In questa attività, sei responsabile dei seguenti compiti:

• Supporto e introduzione a vari sottosorzi di esperti ingegneri di prodotti

• Manutenzione di una piccola gamma di prodotti per quanto riguarda le prestazioni tecniche e applicative

• Preparazione di schede di dati dei prodotti, linee guida delle applicazioni e altri documenti tecnici

• Collaborazione in vari progetti (studi di mercato, piani di sviluppo di mercato)

Le tue competenze ed esperienza
• Una laurea come ingegnere civile, chimico economico o scienziato dei materiali

• La pratica professionale nel settore delle costruzioni è un vantaggio

• Ti piace avvicinarti alle persone, comunicare con stile in tedesco e avere una buona conoscenza dell'inglese (verbale e scritto)

• I vostri punti di forza includono alta auto-motivazione e iniziativa, piacere nel contatto con il cliente e, naturalmente, il morso necessario

Perché dovresti venire da noi
• Entrata in funzione tecnica come ingegnere del prodotto

• Formazione intensiva (6-12 Mte.) – Supporto da esperti ingegneri del prodotto come mentori

• La fiducia è la cosa più importante per noi. Ci fidiamo delle vostre abilità e vi forniamo molti spazi di design – ogni giorno di nuovo

• Dirigenti non complicati che si fidano e un'atmosfera familiare con un tono amichevole - questo è ciò che fa lavorare a Sika speciale - molti di noi lo chiamano lo spirito Sika.
Sika è un grande datore di lavoro – soprattutto per i dipendenti che si affidano alla fiducia in cooperazione.
Attendiamo con ansia il vostro dossier completo.

Offriamo una remunerazione competitiva basata sugli standard del mercato locale e sulle responsabilità specifiche di ogni lavoro. La remunerazione si basa sulle competenze, responsabilità, istruzione e/o formazione pertinenti alla posizione. Ci impegniamo a regimi di remunerazione equa ed equa in conformità con le leggi applicabili, l'Accordo di Tariffa Chimica e i regolamenti.

A proposito di Sika
Sika è una società chimica specializzata, leader globale nello sviluppo e produzione di sistemi e prodotti per incollaggio, sigillatura, vaporizzazione, rinforzo e protezione nella costruzione e nell'industria. Sika ha una presenza globale con filiali in 103 paesi, produce in oltre 400 fabbriche, sviluppa tecnologie innovative per i clienti di tutto il mondo e contribuisce in modo significativo alla trasformazione sostenibile nella costruzione e nei trasporti. Gli oltre 33.000 dipendenti hanno generato un fatturato di 11,20 miliardi di franchi nel 2025.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the role
Are you completing your studies soon and looking for a career start in permanent employment? With us you will get to know the versatile activities of a product engineer. For our professional and well-established team in the Business Support, Technical Department of Sika Schweiz AG, we are looking for a committed, professional and humanly convincing personality as a junior product engineer (80-100%) after agreement in Zurich-Altstetten.
In this activity, you are responsible for the following tasks:

• Support and introduction to various sub-sortia by experienced product engineers

• Maintenance of a small product range with regard to technical and application performance

• Preparation of product data sheets, application guidelines and other technical documents

• Collaboration in various projects (market studies, market development plans)

Your skills and experience
• A university degree as a civil engineer, economic chemist or materials scientist

• Professional practice in the construction industry is an advantage

• You like to approach people, communicate stylishly in German and have good knowledge of English (verbal and written)

• Your strengths include high self-motivation and initiative, pleasure in customer contact and of course the necessary bite

Why you should come to us
• Entry to a technical function as a product engineer

• Intensive training (6-12 Mte.) – Support by experienced product engineers as mentors

• Trust is the most important thing for us. We trust in your skills and provide you with many design spaces – every day anew

• Uncomplicated managers who trust and a family atmosphere with a friendly tone - this is what makes working at Sika special - many of us call it the Sika spirit.
Sika is a great employer – especially for employees who rely on trust in cooperation.
We look forward to your complete application dossier.

We offer competitive remuneration based on local market standards and the specific responsibilities of each job. The remuneration shall be based on the skills, responsibility, education and/or training relevant to the position. We are committed to fair and equitable remuneration schemes in accordance with applicable laws, the Chemicals Tariff Agreement and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemical company, global leader in the development and production of systems and products for gluing, sealing, steaming, reinforcing and protecting in construction and industry. Sika has a global presence with subsidiaries in 103 countries, produces in over 400 factories, develops innovative technologies for customers around the world and thus contributes significantly to the sustainable transformation in construction and transport. The more than 33,000 employees generated a turnover of CHF 11.20 billion in 2025.

About the role
One of our strengths is being able to offer our customers integrative and economical system solutions in order to efficiently coordinate interfaces in the construction process. Through our broad product range with well-known and tested products and systems, we cover all areas of civil engineering and civil engineering. Our technical sales consultants make an important contribution to customer loyalty, acquisition and all phases of property support. Would you also like to be a member of a powerful team? For the East sales region (SG/TG/Appenzell/Rhine Valley and Liechtenstein) we are looking for a technical sales consultant concrete and waterproofing as of January 1, 2027.
In this role, you are responsible for the following tasks:

• Advising and selling Sika products to builders, special processors and in concrete production

• Maintenance of existing and new customer relationships as well as acquisition in the property business in the area of high and high. Civil engineering

• Preparation of offers and tender documents as well as support of objects during execution

• Presentation of high-quality Sika construction solutions at information events and customer events

• Active cooperation with other sales entities

Your skills and experience
• basic technical training in construction; Further training as foremen, polisher or construction manager or construction materials tester

• Your knowledge in the field of concrete technology is another plus

• You are an extroverted, sales-oriented personality

• Negotiation-confident knowledge of German in words and writing, other languages beneficial

• Very good MS Office skills; Salesforce experience is beneficial

• They noticeably enjoy communication, convince other people and bring a flair for advice and sales

• You know the market and the customers in the corresponding sales area

Why you should come to us
• Trust is the most important thing for us. We trust in your skills and provide you with many design spaces – every day anew

• A motivated team with a lot of know-how and an open feedback culture

• Uncomplicated leaders who trust, promote and actively support. A family atmosphere makes working at Sika special – many of us call it the Sika spirit

• Attractive employment conditions and development prospects
We look forward to your complete application dossier (CV, diplomas, certificates, etc.).

We offer competitive remuneration based on local market standards and the specific responsibilities of each job. The remuneration shall be based on the skills, responsibility, education and/or training relevant to the position. We are committed to fair and equitable remuneration schemes in accordance with the applicable laws, the Chemical Tariff Agreement and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemical company, global leader in the development and production of systems and products for gluing, sealing, damping, reinforcing and protecting for the construction and vehicle industries. Sika has a global presence with subsidiaries in 103 countries, produces in over 400 factories and develops innovative technologies for customers around the world, contributing significantly to the sustainable transformation of the construction and vehicle industry. The more than 33,000 employees generated a turnover of CHF 11.2 billion in 2025.

jobs.description:
About the Role
With Operational Technology (OT) playing an increasingly critical role in digital manufacturing and Industry 4.0, we are strengthening our global approach to OT procurement. We are looking for an experienced professional with a background in international chemical manufacturing, strong knowledge of OT systems and proven strategic category management expertise to strengthen our global supplier landscape, drive standardization and unlock value across our production sites. The role requires an international mindset and willingness to travel approximately 40%.

• Develop and implement global procurement strategies for Operational Technology (OT) categories and suppliers

• Manage strategic supplier relationships with leading OT manufacturers, system integrators, and service providers

• Lead negotiations of global framework agreements, contracts, pricing models, and service level agreements

• Identify and realize cost optimization, standardization, and synergy opportunities across regions and sites

• Support local plants in complex sourcing initiatives and contract negotiations while ensuring alignment with global agreements

• Drive lifecycle and vendor performance management to secure reliable and future-proof OT solutions

• Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, third-party risk, and regulatory requirements within procurement activities

• Collaborate closely with OT, Engineering, Operations, Cybersecurity, Legal, and Procurement stakeholders on a global scale

Your Skills and Experience
• University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field

• At least 5 years of experience in strategic category management or indirect procurement, ideally covering IT/OT

• Experience in an international manufacturing environment, preferably in Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Pharmaceuticals, or a similar industry

• Strong knowledge of Operational Technology (OT) systems, such as DCS, SCADA, PLC and MES

• Proven experience negotiating complex service agreements, framework agreements and global supplier contracts

• Fluency in English; German is a strong advantage

• Willingness to travel approximately 40%, mainly within EMEA

• Strong analytical, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to work effectively in an international, matrixed organization

Why Join Us
• We offer competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive work environment that values diversity and inclusion. Join our team and be part of your journey to excellence!

• Sika – Building Trust. Trust is the most important thing for us. We trust in the capabilities of all our Sika team members - every day.

• Friendly, personable, and often surprisingly uncomplicated, that's how many of our employees describe their working relationship at Sika. We call this the Sika Spirit.

• We offer an attractive employment package with good social benefits, excellent pension fund and accident insurance solutions.

jobs.description:
About the Role
Are you interested in ethics, compliance, governance, and responsible business conduct? Do you want to gain hands-on experience in a global company and contribute to a strong culture of integrity?
We are looking for a motivated, curious, and proactive Intern to join our Corporate Compliance team at Sika's global headquarters in Baar for a 12 months contract.
As a Corporate Compliance Trainee, you will contribute to projects that promote integrity, ethical business conduct, and a strong speak-up culture across Sika. You will gain practical experience across different areas of a global corporate compliance function. Depending on business needs and ongoing projects, your responsibilities may include:

• Support international compliance projects and collaborate with colleagues across functions, countries, and cultures.

• Help develop and improve global initiatives, practical tools, guidance materials, and audit checklists.

• Contribute to compliance training, awareness initatives, and communication activities for employees worldwide.

• Research and analyze new regulations, emerging compliance topics, and business trends, and turn your findings into concise briefings or recommendations.

• Develop practical compliance tools, guidance materials, and audit checklists.

• Prepare presentations and reports for management.

• Coordinate project activities from planning to implementation and progress reporting.

• Take ownership of individual assignments, contribute your ideas, and bring a fresh perspective to the team.

Your Skills and Experience
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Compliance, Law, Regulatory Affairs, Business Ethics, Governance, or a related field.

• Strong integrity, sound judgment, and a reliable, responsible working style.

• Curious and eager to learn, with strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

• Well-organized, proactive, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.

• Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working in an international and multicultural environment.

• Fluent in written and spoken English; German and additional languages are an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications; interest in digital and AI-enabled tools is a plus.

• Previous experience through internships, student employment, volunteer work, international exposure, or extracurricular activities is beneficial.

Why Join Us
We offer hands-on experience in the Corporate Compliance function of a global market leader, with exposure to diverse compliance, governance, ethics, and culture topics. From day one, you will take ownership of meaningful assignments, help shape your areas of focus, and collaborate with colleagues worldwide. Dedicated mentoring and coaching from experienced compliance professionals will support your development, while you build a global network and gain valuable skills for a future career in compliance, legal, governance, risk, sustainability, or other corporate functions.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector toward greater environmental compatibility. With more than 33,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.20 billion in 2025.

jobs.description:
About the Role
Support the ESG Controlling Team in Zürich/Altstetten in its digitalization and automation journey, building and maintaining applications and data pipelines that drive automated, scalable ESG reporting.
Main Task

• Software Development: Design, build, and maintain web applications, covering both front-end and back-end development. Understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and contribute to the full software lifecycle from specification through deployment.

Secondary Task (Nice to have)

• CI/CD & Infrastructure: Support the setup and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment (e.g. GitHub Actions, Terraform).

• Data Engineering & Analytics: Develop and maintain data pipelines and workflows in Databricks to support ESG Reporting use cases, including data ingestion, transformation, and modelling.

Your Skills and Experience
Must haves

• Experience with modern web technologies and frameworks (Node.js, Next.js, React) and JavaScript or TypeScript

• Understanding of databases and SQL

• Willingness to learn

• Proactive approach

• Enjoyment of problem solving

• Good communication and teamwork skills

• English language is required, German/Spanish is a plus

Nice to have

• Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g. GitHub Actions) and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform).

• Knowledge of or interest in Databricks, data engineering, Python, and analytics workflows.

• Knowledge of PowerBI

• Familiarity with basic API design principles

• Understanding of data modelling and dbt.

What we offer

• Dynamic and fun team

• Multicultural environment

• Working with senior tech leads

• Visibility to IT management if that is perceived motivating

• Well defined projects in case school requires formal documentations for credit(s)

Why Join Us
We look forward to your application. For this position, only direct applications will be considered.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

About Sika
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector toward greater environmental compatibility. With more than 33,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.20 billion in 2025.

Du analysierst geschäfts- und vertriebsrelevante Fragestellungen, bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf und unterstützt bei Projekten und Digitalisierungsinitiativen.
